tickets.text: Request the current estate planning documents for Arlo and Lena Copperwisp, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. Collect the estate planning documents for the Copperwisp household, noting missing trust funding evidence and updated fiduciary role information, and prepare a gap summary for Nora Pebblefizz.
